memory_experiment_description: Personal Agent and team memory. Existing local memory stays unchanged. Restart Agents after enabling.
memory_description: Manage shared team knowledge and the private memories of Agents you own. Personal memories are shared only when you publish them.
memory_disabled: Platform memory is off for this workspace. Existing Agent memory continues to work.
memory_unavailable: The memory engine is unavailable or is not configured for this workspace. No memory has been changed. Ask an administrator to check the connection.
memory_no_agents: You do not own an Agent in this workspace.
memory_delete_description: Delete this memory and exclude it from future recall. This does not delete the original chat message.
memory_empty: No memories yet. Add a fact, preference or reusable experience.
memory_no_matches: No matching memories. Try another question.
memory_error: The memory operation could not be completed. Your unsaved changes are kept; check access and engine availability, then retry.
memory_conflict: This memory changed or was deleted. Refresh and read the current version before saving again.
memory_cleanup_pending: Memory is saved or excluded from recall. Some old stored files are still awaiting cleanup.
